issues.description: Visibility mismatch for two getters declared in the solution: the problem statement and tests require public getters for all attributes (e.g. getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but in the solution implementation these two methods are declared private. Specifically, solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares "private String getLectureName()" (line 22) and "private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()" (line 30), while the exercise instructions (problem_statement.md) ask students to "Implement getters for each attribute" (lines 30-31). This will prevent external code/tests from calling these methods and will cause test failures or compilation/accessibility errors for student submissions that follow the solution's visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters public in the solution (and in any reference implementation) to match the exercise specification and tests. Change the declarations to: "public String getLectureName()" and "public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()". Alternatively, if the intended design is to keep them non-public, update the problem statement and tests to reflect package-private visibility consistently.
